legend: Bone marrow aspirate smear. The cells are predominantly medium-sized to large myeloblasts with greyish-blue cytoplasm; there is no evidence of maturation beyond the myeloblast stage (<<36856>>). Myeloperoxidase reaction highlights myeloblasts with strong peroxidase expression (<<36857>>). Bone marrow histology shows a uniform proliferation of myeloblasts completely replacing the pre-existing haematopoiesis (<<39580>>).
